notes.title: The Bounty V2.2 Final Update is Live!
notes.notes:
The final update (barring emergency bugfixes) has been uploaded and is now available on Steam.
I'll be doing some reaching out and rounds of promo and everything as time allows, but there's a lot 
going on between this, work going forward, life, and MO Gamecon coming up... so as the story has been 
during this entire rebuild/refresh, I can only devote so much time to this game.

A few changes-
Updated resolution to fit Steam Deck requirements
Tweaked code on spike traps
Updated monster sprites
Updated some character/event sprites
Updated font
Updated dog- you name them, they follow you on the map screen, and you can pet them!
Approximately 23423432 bugs found/created and fixed
Audio tweaks

Store page has been updated with a brand new trailer, and several new screenshots.

You can find more complete lists in other updates.


I'm extremely proud of , and hope people enjoy playing it as much as I did creating it.

notes.notes:
The Bounty V2 is getting it's final update soon, so I thought I'd mention it with the whole
"Going Rogue" event going on!

I'll expand on this in the coming days, along with a ton of other news, but for now I'll just list the highlights.


Updated resolution to fit Steam Deck requirements

Updated monster sprites

Updated font



I'll post more about this update and more, but for now enjoy the sale, and I hope you're looking forward to the update!

notes.title: Halloween Update!
notes.notes:
This Halloween brings some cool new content to The Bounty V2.

All of these new optional, permanent additions are as follows:


New Graphics mode option, which includes not only a new Halloween color palette, but new background props.
New Music- Haunting themes from Richard Tulk's fantastic "Gods and Monsters" E.P
Achievement Event- Find all ten zombies throughout Story Mode to unlock a brand new achievement



Here's a quick look at a couple of screenshots:

notes.title: V2 Update Delayed
notes.notes:
Due to a severe lack of funding, conflicting work scheduling, and family matters- The Bounty: Deluxe Edition's V2 update is delayed until further notice. Work is virtually finished on the development side; but more testing is needed, and I lack the means to properly promote a relaunch such as this. 

I'm sorry to everyone that has been looking forward to this, and hope to have updates on a release as soon as possible. Thanks for your support. -Dave

notes.title: Version 2.0 is nearly here!
notes.notes:
The massive free content update and soft relaunch of The Bounty: Deluxe Edition will be coming in October!

In addition to the expandable Adventure Mode and new graphics options, both Story and Adventure Modes are more speedrun friendly, built to track your playtime during and upon game clear.

Stay tuned for a first look at the new graphics style, game mode, and more in the following weeks.


-Dave Vogt

notes.title: Version 1.2 Progress Report
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31169794/32e8314e14af21bd3fc80b6d4e43bff8f8f1f551.jpg

Work on the (perhaps overly) ambitious version 1.2 patch is moving along nicely. It's taking longer than expected, but I think it'll be well worth the wait. 

A quick refresher-

In Adventure Mode, you're tasked with piecing together the Blade of Legends so you can enter the castle and defeat the final boss. This blade can also be powered up by finding the seven Legendary Orbs hidden within the dungeons- but these are completely optional. Will you rush the castle as quickly as you can, or take your time finding the orbs and boosting your score as high as you can?

The actual player story finds you playtesting a new and incomplete nonlinear game mode. This pushes the envelope a bit more on the 4th wall breaking side; with some pretty big surprises. There are bound to be a few laughs, but you'll have to wait to play it yourself!

Here's a bit on how Adventure Mode is progressing;
All new primary graphics tilesets are finished.
New subsystems are complete and in place.
Of the 14 smaller dungeons, all but a few are fully finished.
2/3 larger dungeons are finished.
All key items are complete, and all but a couple of major events are done.

I want to thank you for your patience. Stay tuned for release info on the free content update!
-Dave

notes.title: Development of Version 1.2 is underway!
notes.notes:
It actually has been for a little while now, but things have been busy!

I'll show previews of the new dungeon skin as soon as possible. It's a TOTALLY unique look, and it's proving difficult, but it will be worth the wait. I hope to launch this update in April, but will keep you all posted! It will accompany a full soft relaunch for press visibility, so it has to be perfect; but I will continue to do my best to get it into your hands in a timely manner.

This update should come with Extra Episode 1- this episode is coming along well, and features some new puzzle and gameplay dynamics, so I hope you look forward to something a little different. The core experience will be unchanged, so if that's a worry, don't!

In other news, Bug Attack! will be receiving it's full Steam release very soon, possibly showing up in the store for wishlisting within the next few days! Have you found the playable Bug Attack! arcade cab in The Bounty yet? If you haven't, keep looking! 

I hope you're all doing well, and wish you happy scorechasing and adventuring.
-Dave
